summary: COSCIENS Biopharma Inc. filed a preliminary management proxy circular for its annual general and special meeting. Shareholders will vote on a share capital amendment: a 1-for-150 consolidation immediately followed by a 50-for-1 subdivision, effectively creating a net dilution of 1:3. Holders with fewer shares than the consolidation ratio will receive $1.60 per pre-consolidation share in cash. The board recommends voting in favor. The mechanical reverse split dilutes small holders; the cash-out price may create a floor for tiny positions. Watch for shareholder approval and execution timeline in June 2026.
